name: Angus McKinnon
bio:
Angus's path to motorsport data analysis began unconventionally, initially studying theoretical physics at the University of Melbourne. He became fascinated with applying complex models to real-world systems, and motorsport provided the perfect blend of high stakes and accessible data. He cut his teeth analyzing amateur racing data, proving his analytical skills and eye for detail. 

He joined Joe Gibbs Racing five years ago and has become an integral part of the team. Angus believes in translating complex data into actionable insights that drivers and engineers can use to improve performance. He's known for his ability to identify subtle trends that others miss, and his relentless pursuit of performance gains makes him a valuable asset. His calm demeanor, even under intense pressure, helps him to stay focused and deliver accurate analysis when it matters most.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Angus is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
